_doc: Where a posted video's poster picture is, for the video's address, which both apps must agree on (2026-11-06, docs/design/media-player.md, 'Rung 2: the poster picture'): the desktop's src/gui/pages/chat/video_poster.rs `poster_url` (its test both_apps_find_a_poster_picture_at_the_same_address) and the website's web/shared/video-poster.js `posterUrlOf` (scripts/tests/video-poster-web.test.js). A video at /uploads/<name> (a bare name: no folder, no query, no fragment, not hidden) has its picture at the same address with .poster.jpg after it, as the relay keeps it (src/relay/storage/files.rs `poster_name`); any other address has none (null).
